newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.945 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves fall to $15.945 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $31 million, or 0.2 percent, in the week to April 7, to $15.945 billion, according to figures released by the central bank.
Reserves were down from $15.976 billion on March 31, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserves have risen $766 million, or five percent.
In 1996 reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, to $15.179 billion.
Government officials have forecast that reserves will grow to $20 billion by the end of 1997.
